authorReviewNote: Archipelago groupofislands, notisthmus/valley/plateau. Actual Cambridge noun definitions checked, both group and surroundingsea sense. Group answer valid, not claiming every island small or politically one country. Category/grammar correct.

Isthmus narrow land joining largerland with waterbothsides. Actual Cambridge geographic definition, not anatomical connection sense. Added watercondition so arbitrary inlandcorridor not equallyfits. Strait/archipelago/craterlake alternatives different. No erroneous requirement connects two continents specifically.

Strait waterpassage, opposite landisthmus. Actual Cambridge water/sea noun definitions checked, ignored difficultfinancialsituation pluralstraits sense. Natural qualifier distinguishes artificialcanal, otherchoices raisedplain/atoll wrong. Largerbodies may oceans/seas/lakes, no two-oceans-only restriction.

Tributary stream/river joins another river or lake. Actual Cambridge explicitly includes lake, added to avoid too-narrow original river-only answer. Mouth/oxbow/dam otherfeatures. No claim every tributary larger than receivingwater or allmainrivers sea-bound.

Coastal estuary typically fresh riverwater and seawater mix. Actual Cambridge geographic mixedwaters definition checked, not Latin etymology question alreadybank. Typically/coastal avoid freshwaterGreatLakes estuaries and seasonallyclosed variants. Otherchoices undergroundriver/permafrost/lavacliff don't define estuary.

Delta buildup by sedimentdeposition near mouth. Cambridge delta definition alone did not prove process, so actual NPS DeltaLandforms deposition/supply/removal paragraph inspected and source replaced. Windmountaintop/glacialvalley/lavacooling different processes. No everydelta triangular assertion.

Fjord long narrow steep-sided seainlet glacialorigin. Cambridge shape plus actual NPS glacier-carved floodedvalley passage checked, primaryNPS source used. Oxbow/dune/atoll different. Usually scope permits modifiedinlets, no claim Norway-only.

Atoll coralring encirclinglagoon. Actual Cambridge atoll definition inspected. Rivergorge/floodplain/isthmus wrong. Reef/island wording permits broken-ring forms and reefstructures; no false requirement inhabited or perfectly circular.

Coastal lagoon shallowwater behind reef/sandbar/barrier. Actual Cambridge coastal definition explicitly separation, not inland reservoir or snowfield. Otherchoices waterfall/drychannel/permafrost not lagoon. No absolute requirement sealed from tides or always fresh water.

Plateau raisedrelativelyflatland. Actual Cambridge geography noun checked rather than levelled-off trend/verb. Strait/riverbend/coralislands different. Relatively flat avoids perfectlyhorizontal promise, raised relative neighbours not fixedheightthreshold.

Valley lowerground betweenhills/mountains, notcoralinlet/mountaintop/ridge. Actual Cambridge noun definition checked. Often river but not mandatory, so dryvalleys included. No U-only/V-only shape restriction.

Plain broad relativelyflatland, nottrench/volcaniccone/coralring. Inspected actual noun geographic definition after many unrelated adjective/plainknitting meanings. Does not impose universally low absolute altitude, allowing HighPlains. Clear physicalgeography scope in stem.

Land-based sanddune wind-shaped mound/ridge. Cambridge sandhill plus NPS actual dune formation by movingair/water checked. Added land-based to avoid underwater current-formed sanddunes. Otherchoices earthquakecrack/glacierlake/coralcliff wrong. No claim water never influences coastaldune supply.

Oasis desertwater supportsplants, noticesheet/trench/glacialpass. Actual Cambridge literal desertdefinition, ignored figurative peacefulplace. Doesn't require village or palm specifically, and doesn't assert all desertwater at surface in openpool. Meaning/grammar clear.

Coastal bay seainlet partlyenclosedland. Actual Cambridge coastcurves-aroundsea noun checked, not parkingbay/tree/horse/dogverb. Scoped coastal rather than asserting lakebays nonexistent. Ridge/snowfield/tributary not this coastalfeature.

Cape projectslandintosea, notlagoon/undervalley/archipelago. Actual Cambridge landform noun checked rather than clothing/defendingverb. No requirement clothing-shape or specificsize threshold. Coastalscope explicit to disambiguate word.

Confluence streamsmeet, notsource/dam/cutoffbend. Actual Cambridge riverjunction definition read, not abstractmerger. Plural rivers/streams accommodates morethantwo meeting; doesn't claim all waterways become sea at point. New definition distinct from old Wuhan/Cairo named-confluence places.

Meander windingriverbend, notfall/undergroundsource/dam. Actual Cambridge rivercurve noun checked as well as riverwindingverb; ignored aimlesswalking/textsense. Does not say everybend circular or permanently fixed. Clear geography.

Floodplain relativelyflatnear-river land liableflooding. Actual Cambridge literal lowflatfloodland definition inspected. Divide/seaice/unconnected-valley wrong. Canbe flooded permits protectionlevees/rare floods without insisting annualinundation. Not a changing floodwarning question.

Oxbow forms when riverbend cut off into separatelake. Actual Cambridge full curvedlake/newstraightercourse definition inspected. Underseavolcano/glaciermelting/desertwind alternatives unrelatedprocesses. Typically allows engineering-assisted cutoff, no guarantee all riverbends become lakes.

Rapids fastturbulent stretches, notstillpools/mouths/undergroundreservoirs. Cambridge fastflowingriverpart definition inspected. No need everyrapid navigable/dangerous, speed and turbulence standarddescription. Correct plural agreement.

Steep riverdrop creates waterfall, notestuary/atoll/plateau. Actual Cambridge waterdroppinghigher-to-lower rockyedge definition checked. No strictheight or perfectlyvertical threshold asserted; cascades permitted. Simple but meaningful accessible geofact.

Gorge deepnarrowsteep-sidedvalley. Actual Cambridge geological noun checked, ignored overeating/anger idioms. Seainlet/plateau/coralring distinct. Usually rivercut but no mandatoryactive-river claim, so drygorges included.

Glacier flowinglargeicemass underownweight, notcloud/seasonalseaice/stormriver. Actual NSIDC growing/movingglacier passage explicitly ownweight flow checked, beyond generic dictionary definition. Allows icecaps/valleyglaciers, does not falsely say ice always stationary.

Moraine glacialrock/debris transported/deposited, notcoral/dune/lava. Actual Cambridge carriedglacier/leftaftermelting definition inspected. Doesn't require one specificridgelocation or perfectlysortedparticles. Debris on/along/in glacier fits, no all sedimentglacial claim.
